claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Diphenhydramine at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells; its only plausible cytotoxic contribution is weak cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress at high micromolar concentrations, far above the H1-antagonist range.
